```{python}
#| output: asis
import pathlib
import yaml

# Assume you run "quarto render ..." from the repo root
project_cv = pathlib.Path(".").resolve()
project_root = project_cv.parent  # cv/ -> repo root
yaml_path = (project_root / "src" / "generated" / "cv.generated.yml").resolve()

if not yaml_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError("YAML not found: " + str(yaml_path))

cv = yaml.safe_load(yaml_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

def s(x):
    if x is None:
        return ""
    return str(x).strip()

def md_bold(text):
    return "**" + text + "**"

def authors_line(authors):
    # authors: [{name: "...", highlight: bool}, ...]
    if not authors:
        return ""
    names = []
    for a in authors:
        name = s(a.get("name"))
        if a.get("highlight"):
            name = md_bold(name)
        names.append(name)
    if len(names) == 1:
        return names[0]
    if len(names) == 2:
        return names[0] + " & " + names[1]
    return ", ".join(names[:-1]) + ", & " + names[-1]

def doi_to_url(doi):
    doi = s(doi)
    if not doi:
        return ""
    if doi.startswith("http://") or doi.startswith("https://"):
        return doi
    return "https://doi.org/" + doi

def pub_tail(pub):
    venue = s(pub.get("venue"))
    vol = s(pub.get("volume"))
    issue = s(pub.get("issue"))
    pages = s(pub.get("pages"))

    parts = []
    if venue:
        parts.append("*" + venue + "*")

    vi = ""
    if vol and issue:
        vi = vol + "(" + issue + ")"
    elif vol:
        vi = vol
    elif issue:
        vi = "(" + issue + ")"

    if vi:
        parts.append(vi)
    if pages:
        parts.append(pages)

    if not parts:
        return ""
    return ", ".join(parts) + "."

def pub_links(pub):
    links = pub.get("links") or {}
    doi = s(links.get("doi"))
    pdf = s(links.get("pdf"))
    other = s(links.get("other"))

    out = []
    if doi:
        out.append("[DOI](" + doi_to_url(doi) + ")")
    if pdf:
        out.append("[PDF](" + pdf + ")")
    if other:
        out.append("[Link](" + other + ")")

    if not out:
        return ""
    return " " + " ".join(out)

def heading(title):
    print("")
    print("## " + title)
    print("")
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
heading("Positions")

for p in cv.get("positions", []) or []:
    start = s(p.get("start"))
    end = s(p.get("end"))
    role = s(p.get("role"))
    org = s(p.get("org"))
    location = s(p.get("location"))

    date = ""
    if start or end:
        date = start + "–" + end + ": "

    loc = ""
    if location:
        loc = " (" + location + ")"

    print("- " + date + md_bold(role) + ", " + org + loc)
```


```{python}
#| output: asis
heading("Publications")

pubs = cv.get("publications", []) or []

for pub in pubs:
    a = authors_line(pub.get("authors", []))
    y = s(pub.get("year"))
    title = s(pub.get("title"))

    line = ""
    if a:
        line += a + ". "
    if y:
        line += "(" + y + "). "
    line += title + ". "

    tail = pub_tail(pub)
    if tail:
        line += tail

    line += pub_links(pub)

    print("- " + line.strip())
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
heading("Honors and Awards")

for h in cv.get("honors_and_awards", []) or []:
    year = s(h.get("year"))
    title = s(h.get("title"))
    org = s(h.get("org"))

    line = ""
    if year:
        line += year + ": "
    line += title
    if org:
        line += " - " + org

    print("- " + line)
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
heading("Conferences and Presentations")

for t in cv.get("conferences_and_presentations", []) or []:
    date = s(t.get("date"))
    typ = s(t.get("type"))
    title = s(t.get("title"))
    event = s(t.get("event"))
    location = s(t.get("location"))

    prefix = ""
    if date:
        prefix += date + " "
    if typ:
        prefix += "[" + typ + "] "

    loc = ""
    if location:
        loc = " (" + location + ")"

    print("- " + prefix + title + ". " + "*" + event + "*" + loc)
```
